svg.text: SEPARATION OF CONCERNS: NORMATIVE SPECIFICATION VS. REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATIONS
Relationship between vendor-neutral functional requirements and open-source reference software (Apache 2.0)
SPECIFICATION TRACK · FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
Scope: Declarative Data Governance, Quality Dimensions & Cryptographic Attestation
1. Technology-Agnostic Functional Criteria
• Specifies deterministic criteria for runtime constraint evaluation and audit records
• Grounded in ISO/IEC 38505-1 (EDM) and ISO/IEC 25012 / ISO 8000-8 quality models
• Normative Schemas: JSON Schema Draft-07, W3C OWL 2 & LinkML
2. Standardized Work Products
• Work Product 1: Provenance-Attested Constraint & Context Binding Schemas
• Work Product 2: Semantic Certificate (S-Cert) Audit Payload Schema (RFC 8785 JCS)
payload_hash + definition_hash + config_hash + correlation_id
3. Clean Legal & Architectural Boundary
• Specification is decoupled from any single runtime or platform vendor
• Normative references cite international standards & open W3C/IETF specifications
• Implementable independently in Python, Node.js, Java, Rust, Go, or SQL
IMPLEMENTATION TRACK · INFORMATIVE REFERENCE SOFTWARE
Open-Source Ecosystem Alignment: Federated Dataspaces & Data Pipelines (Apache 2.0)
1. Vendor-Neutral Reference Software (Apache 2.0)
• Headless runtime Policy Enforcement Point (PEP) and S-Cert generator
• Demonstrates cross-language parity across Python and Node.js runtimes
• Informative status only; conformance is strictly to the written specification
2. Interoperability with Dataspace Control-Plane Components
• Eclipse CAP (v2.2.1): Exports S-Cert as W3C VC v2.0 cred:Evidence
• Eclipse DRP & W3C ODRL 2.2: Enforces bound usage obligations at runtime
• Gaia-X DTA & DSP Connectors: Verifies post-transfer obligations at data plane
3. Conformance Testing & Verification
• Open test suite for Level 1 (Core) and Level 2 (Attested) conformance
• Deterministic RFC 8785 (JCS) SHA-256 hashing & RFC 7515 (JWS) signatures
• Enables independent third-party audit without exposing raw data payloads
DECOUPLED
Spec ≠ Code
